# Merchant Guild

The Merchant Guild is a neutral trading organization dedicated to commerce and profit above all else. Headquartered at the bustling [[locations/port_verath]], they maintain trade routes across the known world.

## Trading Operations

The Guild manages shipyards, warehouses, and trading posts throughout the realm. Despite their neutrality, they have been forced to negotiate with the [[factions/crimson_order]] in order to maintain trade access through northern territories.

## Philosophy

The Merchant Guild believes that free trade benefits everyone and works tirelessly to keep trade routes open regardless of political conflicts between other factions.
